messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Then, more measurable weight loss occurs in the first 2 to 3 months, and increases over 6 to 12 months (SURMOUNT-1). To learn more, see ” How long does it take for Zepbound to work?"
Triplet: ["Tirzepatide", "has effect on fullness", "increased fullness"]

The relation 'has effect on fullness' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug affects the sensation of fullness, resulting in the level of fullness specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'increases level of': The subject drug increases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
C. 'may reduce response to': The subject drug may diminish the physiological or therapeutic response to the medication specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dose adjustment based on': The dosage of the subject drug may be modified according to the factor specified by the object entity.
E. 'has typical weight gain': The subject drug is associated with a typical amount of weight gain specified by the object entity over a given time period.
F. None of the above.
